events.title: Miracle ticket
events.body: A kind stranger presses a miracle into your hand. “Someone didn’t show. Don’t ask questions.”

events.title: Flat tire
events.body: The beater lists hard. You’re on the shoulder swapping rubber in light you wouldn’t describe as legal.

events.title: Robbed
events.body: Someone rummaged while you slept at a rest stop. Your stash took a hit. The universe offers no receipt.

events.title: Hitchhiker with intel
events.body: A hitchhiker knows too much about tonight’s venue. They want a beer for directions that might be real.

events.title: Wook flu
events.body: The crew is wrecked. Fever dreams of rail-riding unicorns. Rest now or HR gets your application.

events.title: Pulled over
events.body: Blue lights. The officer asks how many are in the vehicle and whether you know why you were weaving. Your crew goes quiet in that specific way.

events.title: Rest stop bathroom find
events.body: A baggie sits on the tile behind the toilet paper. Could be anything. Could be a federal case. Could be nothing.

events.title: Lot rumor
events.body: Someone swears {song} opens tonight — a deep cut, they say. Bet $20 it hits the set?
